title: 道徳教育の理論と実践
subtitle: Principles and Practices in Moral Education
educationalGoal: Students will learn the theory and practice of moral education and think about methods of future moral education. Students will clarify the relation between “moral education to be carried out through all instructional activities of the school” and “moral education to be performed during morality class”, and develop the basic abilities, knowledge, and instruction methods necessary for morality (i.e., “that I think and discuss”).
advice:
Students will learn about the theory of moral education and morality in the future while connecting theories of moral education with actual practice. Students will also argue for an appointed theme in groups and summarize the content in a worksheet:
  1. Moral education and problems in the morality department
  2. Moral education theory
    ① Historic process of moral education
    ② Theories about moral education
    ③ Moral education management
    ④ Moral education and “Special subject: Morality”
  3. Morality class theory
    ① Morality for thought and discussion
    ② Teaching materials
  4. Transmission of values and critical thought
  5. Moral education for future society
books: Textbooks：Middle School Curriculum - Commentary - “Special subject: Morality” (Higashiyama Publishing) 〈Tyugakkou-Gakusyuusidou-Youryou Kaisetu “Tokubetsu-no-Kyouka-Doutoku〉 Morality for Thought and Discussion - Making Classes with Active Moral Learning- 〈Kangae, Gironnsuru-Doutokujugyou- Active Moral Learning- no-Jugyouzukuri〉
requiredKnowledge:
●Applicants for a junior high school teacher's license must take this class.
●Applicants for a high school teacher's license should take this class.
●Students should have a strong desire to enter the teaching profession.
●Students should want to improve their understanding of moral education continuously.
●Students must participate in practice, mock classes, and positive discussions.

activityGoals.body: Can explain the social background of “Special subject: Morality”.
Can explain the theory and practice of moral education using specific examples.
Can understand the purpose of morality education, develop teaching plans and materials, and conduct classes.
Learn with a sincere attitude and self-evaluate their action targets.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Students will understand the theory of moral education and be able to explain its effectiveness, limits, and characteristics using concrete examples.(2) Students can understand the association between moral education and everyday life and devise a class plan in accordance with the actual situation of schools and students.
(3) Students will have a clear understanding of moral education that can be used as a basis to develop appropriate morality teaching materials and effective utilization methods.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Students will understand the theory of moral education and be able to explain its effectiveness, limits, and characteristics.
(2) Students can understand the association between moral education and everyday life and devise a class plan.
(3) Students will have a clear understanding of moral education that can be used as a basis to develop appropriate morality teaching materials.
